name: Learow
dexEntry: ''It offered me a choice. It offered me safety, a chance. I accepted, despite knowing better. Once I saw the light of the moon cast down on me, I wasn't human, not at the moment. I was a bird. Murkrow, but that form didn’t last long as I reverted back to normal. A human with a full black, inky right arm. A black hat resting on my head with a tail wagging slowly behind me. The role I was given; to weed out the weak. I accepted with haste.''
